    border-color: #0051ff #d400ff #00ffff #04ff00;
    transform: rotate(5deg) scale(1.3);
  }

  75% {
    border-color: #04ff00 #0051ff #d400ff #00ffff;
    transform: rotate(-5deg) scale(1.3);
  }

  100% {

    transform: rotate(5deg) scale(1.3);
